READING
A day changes the top-20 movers 1.091x as much as re-measuring the same day at the
same depth does. Compare the cell-state gate on the three per-cell lines: RPE1 g2m 1.638,
Jurkat s 1.370, HepG2 g2m 1.310 -- state moves the answer further than a day does, so the state
effect is NOT time in disguise. Both are real; they are not the same axis.
